ADVENTURE BOARD

Choose your next challenge.

Rewards and collected tokens save locally. Replay rewards are 25%. Car/bike selection is automatic for missions. Stop at the finish. Sky falls automatically restore your last checkpoint with a five-second penalty.

Cheat console

Type a code and press Spawn / apply. Your new vehicle appears at your current position.

car · random carbike · trail bikehelicopter · flytraffic · pushable carrepair · restore dentsfuel · fill tankblast · explode vehiclebus / truck / ambulance Heavy & service vehiclessuv / pickup / buggy Off-road fleethospital / shop / apartment Set building GPS
Car / bike: Shift + Space launches; tap Space alone for more jumps in the air. Space drifts on ground and jumps in air; A/D air steering, W/S pitch. Shift boosts in your facing direction, even in the air. Helicopter: hold Space ↑, Q ↓, W/S fly, A/D turn. Arcade crash effects, not a soft-body simulator.

GPS & expedition travel

Road-following routes with turn prompts, distance and ETA. Mission checkpoints guide you automatically.

City Life · enterable buildings

Directions to the nearest green entrance. Stop, E to walk, F to enter. Interiors load one at a time.

Wild Frontier · quick travel

Also reachable by the west causeway. Discover nineteen expedition sites; M opens the local trail map.

City road navigation

Custom city destination: double-click a road on the full map (M). Cyan line = GPS route; F = fuel station. Remote mission locations have their own course navigation.

About this world

Offline play, compatibility and original asset credits.

About this level & credits

Original three-island level layout and procedural game textures. Photographic road, pavement, brick, concrete, grass, sand and sky: Poly Haven, CC0. Glass and painted plaster are separate lightweight materials. Cars: Generic passenger car pack by Comrade1280, CC BY 4.0. Models rescaled; the long Tourer uses a stretched wagon conversion. Wheels in these imported models are static. Three.js and pako: MIT. This is an arcade driving prototype, not a photorealistic city, a GTA port, or a full crash simulation. Trees, road decals, furnishings, light snow and material variants are generated geometry/textures; base photographic textures retain their original credits.
